RESULT 1: 5/8 < 5/6, so this candidate does not reach the bound. A family attaining ratio → 5/6 is not yet identified.

CHECK 2 <- REFUTER SUBGOAL 2: find a counterexample cubic with ratio above 5/6.
RESULT 2: not run. Searching for one requires an optimization over four coefficients with absolute values and a root constraint, which I have not carried out.

The lower bound needs an explicit sequence of cubics whose ratios converge to 5/6, with integrals of absolute values computed in Lean. Neither piece is in hand.
